seoTitle: Unit Test Stub Generator: Jest, Vitest, pytest from Signatures
metaDescription: Paste JavaScript, TypeScript or Python functions and get test stubs with edge-case inputs from parameter names, types and defaults, and throw tests.
intro: Generate test skeletons for your functions, with edge-case inputs derived from their signatures.
why:
Writing the first test file is the boring part. This generator parses function declarations (function, async, arrow functions in JS and TS; def and async def in Python), builds a describe/it block or pytest test per function, derives edge-case arguments from parameter names, annotations and defaults (empty and Unicode strings, zero and negative numbers, empty lists, null) and adds a throws test when it sees a throw or raise.

It is a signature parser, not an AI: you still write the arrange and assert steps, which is where the thinking is. Parsing is regex-based, so complex generics, decorators and nested functions may need manual touch-ups. Your code stays in your browser.
howTo: Choose Jest, Vitest or pytest and the module path.

faq.a: No, it is deterministic parsing and templates.
